The web overflow-x-auto scrollbar-none row becomes a horizontal ScrollView with the indicator hidden; the responsive hidden-sm middle-item collapse + ellipsis has no RN media-query analogue so all crumbs render (the web sm-and-wider behavior).

Imports only React and React Native primitives plus the shared AppText component and theme tokens; no DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, lucide, react-router, or old web UI components are referenced.
